user_instruction: Restore all motor geometry for ordinary body/geom viewers; all four three-motor modules lumped into hip at 2 kg each, COM at the hip motor housing center indicated in screenshots. No independent thigh_drive COMs. Each thigh frame/linkage group remains 0.300 kg.
inertia_convention: Source SolidWorks products of inertia negated once, rotated into CAD root/body axes, then aggregated with the parallel-axis theorem. Structural central tensors scaled uniformly with mass; COMs retained from their own components.
estimate_scope: Hip COM placement follows the user image region, implemented as housing geometric center. Hip central tensors are scaled CAD aggregate estimates. Structural thigh distribution is CAD based with a user-specified 0.300 kg total.
